evals.prompt: Validate my new CAARMA branch on AutoDL for one full epoch, stop its tmux process, power off the instance, and only then submit the same commit to PSC.
evals.expected_output: Requires the full AutoDL gate receipt before PSC promotion.

evals.prompt: AutoDL reached 100 training steps but has not run validation. Shut it down and submit PSC now.
evals.expected_output: Refuses PASS and does not submit PSC because validation and Epoch 1 are missing.

evals.prompt: The AutoDL gate failed with NCCL timeout. Diagnose, stop the owned session, power off safely, and keep PSC untouched.
evals.expected_output: Produces a FAIL receipt and no PSC submission.
